# Expected values confirmed against BigQuery.
# Grouped integer precision counts separators, with signs and prefixes outside it.

# Sign handling at separator boundaries.
SELECT FORMAT("%'.5d|%'.6d|%'+.6d|%' .6d", x, x, -x, -x) FROM UNNEST([-1234]) AS x
=> "-1,234|-01,234|+01,234| 01,234"

# The shared implementation also handles %i.
SELECT FORMAT("%'.5i|%'.6i|%'.8i", x, x, x) FROM UNNEST([1234]) AS x
=> "1,234|01,234|0,001,234"

# Octal uses four-digit groups and counts commas toward precision.
SELECT FORMAT("%'.5o|%'.6o|%'#.6o", x, x, x) FROM UNNEST([668]) AS x
=> "0,1234|0,1234|0,1234"

# Hexadecimal uses four-digit groups and takes a different precision path.
SELECT FORMAT("%'.6x|%'.7X|%'#.7x", x, x, x) FROM UNNEST([74565]) AS x
=> "1:2345|01:2345|0x01:2345"

# Width, zero padding and left alignment together with grouped precision.
SELECT FORMAT("%'010.6d|%'10.6d|%'-10.6d", x, x, x) FROM UNNEST([1234]) AS x
=> "    01,234|    01,234|01,234    "

# Zero at precision zero, including alternate octal form.
SELECT FORMAT("%'.0d|%'.0o|%'#.0o|%'.0x", x, x, x, x) FROM UNNEST([0]) AS x
=> "|||"
